sources.name: A_DOCK-permit.txt
sources.text:
Scene 301 quay filming must wait until a signed electrical isolation certificate and written dock access approval are presented.

During Scene 301 the cable run must have load-rated cable covers and anti-slip interlocking panels, and a qualified marine electrician must remain at the distribution board throughout the take.

For Scene 302 pedestrian close-ups, written pier manager consent and non-marking shoe covers are mandatory.

Visitor information: the souvenir kiosk opens at noon and sells tide charts.
